verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents Superhuman Command (Cmd+K), which can 'instantly do any action' and teaches the matching shortcut, and it advertises fast keyboard shortcuts. Users corroborate that every interaction can be done from the keyboard. The 'never make me wait' speed element is contested: one hands-on user reports blazing-fast search and transitions, but another reports archive searches regularly taking ten seconds, and others report RAM bloat and occasional crashes needing a restart. missing for 10: consistent independent evidence that the interface never makes users wait (search latency is contradicted), and a documented comprehensive shortcut reference.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can do everything from the keyboard — comprehensive shortcuts and a command palette — in an interface fast enough to never make me wait

citations.quote: Cmd+K brings up Superhuman Command, where you can instantly do any action
and also learn the shortcut for next time
You can reply to important messages faster with blazingly fast shortcuts
every interaction in Superhuman can be done from the keyboard, like an email version of vim
search and UI transitions are blazing fast
